summary_md: **Alejandro Maldonado ([@AlexM0302](https://x.com/AlexM0302/status/2116516059104878918))** summarizes *Loud Failures, Quiet Failures* by Obada Kraishan ([arXiv 2610.10062](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10062)): agents caught tools that threw errors 91% of the time but plausible wrong values only 59%, and prompting to check results did not help; he advises schema, range and cross-source checks in code.
